```yaml
name: Release Scrapers

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  release-scrapers:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y libev4 libonig5

      - name: Build scraper
        run: |
          make -C src/scrapers clean
          make -C src/scrapers all

      - name: Create release draft
        id: create_release
        uses: release-drafter/release-drafter@v6
        with:
          config-name: release-drafter-config.yml
          name: Scraper Release
          tag: scraper-latest
          version: 0.0.0
          prerelease: true
          publish: false

      - name: Upload scraper binary
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          file: src/scrapers/_build/default/src/scrapers/scrape.exe
          asset_name: scrape.exe
          tag: scraper-latest
          overwrite: true
          prerelease: true
```
